seoTitle: CSV Export — Meaning and Example for Businesses
metaDescription: A CSV export downloads data as a plain comma-separated file that opens in any spreadsheet application. Downloading your data as a spreadsheet-readable file.
definition: A CSV export downloads data as a plain comma-separated file that opens in any spreadsheet application. It is the lowest common denominator for moving data between systems.
bodyHtml:
Why CSV Export matters

Export capability is what stops software from holding your business hostage. Any tool without a usable export becomes a trap the day you want to change it or hand data to your accountant.

How CSV Export works in practice

Check before adopting any tool that it exports the data you would actually need — transactions, masters and balances. Sending your accountant a CSV beats screenshots by a wide margin.

faq.question: Why does my CSV open wrongly in Excel?
faq.answer: Usually a delimiter or encoding mismatch. Importing rather than double-clicking, and choosing UTF-8, fixes most cases.

faq.question: What should I export before switching software?
faq.answer: Transactions, item and customer masters, outstanding balances and stock positions.
